_comment: Candidate engine v0 thresholds. Observations, not alerts. Changing a value changes rules_version only through a git commit.

watchlist._comment: probation = every new pump coin for early_window_s seconds (unique-buyer counts come from here). subscribe_graduations: a graduation puts the coin on the watchlist (reason graduation) only for a funded PumpPortal key; the RPC trade stream never subscribes after graduation (milestone 3), the tracker samples graduated coins. rpc_trades_cap caps the number of per-mint logsSubscribe subscriptions; above rpc_trades_cu_drop_fraction of the daily CU cap only the rpc_trades_keep_reasons_above_cu_fraction reasons keep a subscription (probation is dropped first). The per-subscription and per-hour limits of the stream live in config/ingest.json -> rpc_trades.
